# CLI Reference

This reference is generated from the native CLI command descriptors in `packages/cli/src/lib/commands/*.ts` and the root command options in `packages/cli/src/bin/index.ts`.

## Global options

- `--config <profile-name>` — Use configuration from profile
- `--config-path <path>` — Use configuration from file
- `--progress` — Global flag, used to display progress (currently used only in 'si seq send/deploy' command
